## What I'm trying to do

One or two sentences. (Example: _"set up Ableton-RC-Surface so my iPad can control the EQ Eight on track 3"_).

## What I've done so far

Steps already taken, even if they failed. Helps avoid re-asking the obvious.

## Environment (if relevant)

- Ableton Live version
- OS + browser on the phone
- Extension version (`Ableton-RC-Surface-X.Y.Z.ablx`)

## Where I looked

Did you check `docs/INSTALL.md`, `docs/FAQ.md`, or search closed issues? If yes, mention what you searched and what didn't match.

## Quick repro (optional)

If this turns into a bug we can repro, attach a screen recording or the steps.
